orders: Perform the finger-to-nose-to-finger test to assess for cerebellar intention tremor
Test rapid alternating movements (dysdiadochokinesia) in both hands
Examine for dystonic posturing or sensory tricks in the tremulous limb
Order thyroid function tests to rule out hyperthyroidism
Order serum ceruloplasmin and 24-hour urinary copper to rule out Wilson's disease
Order an MRI brain with focus on the cerebellum and basal ganglia
Check a comprehensive metabolic panel including electrolytes, calcium, and liver function
Screen for recent use of tremor-inducing medications or substances (e.g., salbutamol, lithium, valproate, caffeine, stimulants)
